text: Ko jantaa ko'o e wonndoore seedeeɓe ɓen ɗiɗo ɓaawo julde nden, tuma nde woondoore maɓɓe nden sikkitaa, e ruttugol seedee maɓɓe on, ko ɗum ɓuri ɓaɗtaade nde ɓe addata seedee e hoore nden ɗon ; wata ɓe waylu woondoore nden maa ɓe janfoo e mayre, ko ɗum kadi ɓuri ɓaɗtaade nde ɓe hulata yo woondoore ndonndi nden ruttetee ɓaawo woondoore maɓɓe nden, ɓe seeditoo ko lunndii seedee maɓɓe on ɓe wirtoo. Hulee Alla accon fenannde e janfa ka woondooje e ka seedagol, nanon jaɓon ko waajaɗon. Alla fewnataa ɓen yaltuɓe e ɗoftaare.
